Yes, DR-9001 has been decided, and it was approved. Michael Torres, VP Sales, signed off on 2026-09-24.

- **Record:** The decision is logged as DEC-2026-0001, owned by Revenue Operations. The governance agent decided it on 2026-09-23 under the discount-approval procedure.
- **Outcome:** APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION. Acme was eligible for the full 15%, the maximum allowed.
- **Why Michael Torres had to approve:** Under the Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 and the Approval Authority Matrix APP-MATRIX-2026, Sarah Chen can approve up to 10%. A 15% discount needed a VP Sales.
- **Eligibility basis:** Two documents cover it:
  - Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025, §3.2.
  - Schedule B pricing exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15. It allows up to 15% on the NS-500 only, from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. It replaced the older 10% exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-10) for requests dated on or after 2025-04-01.

```
